parts.name: Tube
parts.notes: 2" OD x 0.065" wall x 1.87" ID 6061-T6 drawn round tube, cut to 4.00" (101.6 mm). Price estimated (short cut piece). McMaster's anodized 6061 tube line may also have this in black: check before ordering; if so the anodize step drops out.

parts.name: Tube window + black anodize (local NYC machine shop)
parts.notes: Estimate. Mill one 36 x 56 mm window (3 mm corner radius) through the tube front, 36-92 mm from the bottom end; deburr; Type II black anodize. ~$70 one-off, ~$15-20 each in a batch of 50+. Drawing = Tube STL.

parts.name: ESP32-CAM (AI-Thinker)
parts.notes: Search: "ESP32-CAM-MB with OV2640 camera". Kit = ESP32-CAM + ESP32-CAM-MB + OV2640 (66 deg). Board 27 x 40.5 x 4.5 mm.

parts.name: ESP32-CAM-MB programmer
parts.notes: Included in the ESP32-CAM kit. 40 x 27 mm, CH340, micro-USB.

parts.name: Status LED (3 mm)
parts.notes: Search: "3mm LED assortment" (use a green one).

parts.name: 220 ohm resistor
parts.notes: Search: "1/4W resistor assortment". In series with the LED.

parts.name: 6x2 mm magnet
parts.notes: Search: "6x2mm neodymium magnets". Press-fit into the sled; detents for the steel shutter (open / closed).

parts.name: Rubber bumper feet
parts.notes: Search: "8mm x 2.5mm black bumper feet adhesive".

parts.name: Micro-USB cable 2 m
parts.notes: Search: "micro USB cable 6ft black". Plug body must be <= 11 x 8 mm.

parts.name: 5V 2A USB wall adapter
parts.notes: Search: "5V 2A USB wall charger UL listed".

parts.name: M2.5×8 self-tapping screw for plastic
parts.notes: search: M2.5 x 8mm pan head self tapping screws for plastic

parts.name: M3×16 self-tapping screw for plastic
parts.notes: search: M3 x 16mm pan head self tapping screws for plastic

soldering_reason: The status LED and its resistor are soldered to two header pins on the ESP32-CAM (3 small joints).
